setup: Register resultless/resultful ephemeral/durable definitions through IWorkflowDefinitionRegistry.
assertion: Exactly four typed handle families return closed Registered, HostIncompatible, or Conflict results without casts.
expectedRed: The common typed registry is absent.

setup: Register definitions with mode mismatch, missing static transient/durable pools, and fingerprint conflict while mutating supplied name collections.
assertion: Validation order is mode then copied distinct ordinal-sorted missing names then fingerprint; failure mutates no registry/provider state.
expectedRed: Final host compatibility results are absent.

setup: Call GetHandleOrThrow on every registration/start result variant.
assertion: Success returns the same handle; failures throw the exact typed exception carrying the unchanged conflict/failure.
expectedRed: Closed unions and convenience exceptions are absent.

setup: Start/reopen resultless and resultful instances and race completion with WaitForOutputAsync subscription/cancellation.
assertion: Typed output is notification-driven with subscribe-then-recheck; local cancellation does not cancel workflow and terminal no-output throws WorkflowOutputUnavailableException.
expectedRed: Final typed handles and notification wait are absent.

setup: Inspect snapshots and management members during running, waiting, retrying, and terminal states.
assertion: Only committed state, active wait deadline, outcome/failure, cancellation request, and termination exist; running deadline/attempt facts and enumeration/bulk/query/statistics/deferred lifecycle operations are absent.
expectedRed: Current management surface is broader and provisional.

setup: Reflect and invoke payloadless/generic instance and correlation delivery routes.
assertion: IWorkflowEventClient exposes exactly two route names/four overloads and five statuses with engine-role-owned implementations.

setup: Reflect each package in isolation for ephemeral engine, durable engine, durable ingress, in-memory provider, PostgreSQL provider, and DAG registration.
assertion: Exactly six methods exist in their specified assemblies/classes with exact options and no duplicated/partial/catch-all owner.
expectedRed: Split packages and entry points are absent.

setup: Combine ephemeral/durable, engine/ingress, missing/duplicate provider, and DAG-without-durable roles.
assertion: Conflicts fail deterministically before partial registration; callback ingress remains definition-less and PostgreSQL supplies one complete production role set.
expectedRed: Current hosting uses provisional combined roles.

setup: Register null/default/duplicate/nonpositive/mutable options and mutate source collections afterward.
assertion: Typed options are copied and validated immediately without binder APIs, silent defaults, toggles, codec hooks, or serializer replacement.
expectedRed: Exact programmatic options contract is absent.

setup: Configure StepExecutionThrottle for exact/base/derived named steps and ephemeral lambdas.
assertion: Only the exact Then<TStep> type is throttled; assignability and lambda inference do not match.

setup: Apply WithTransientPool after named/lambda steps and after ineligible structure/decorators.
assertion: It binds only the immediately preceding eligible ephemeral business step and duplicate/misplaced use fails eagerly.
